name: NexoWatt EOS Admin
fixes: hard fallback write dialog for writable ObjectBrowser value cells when the native React click path is blocked or not opened
module-federation adapter-react chunk is cache-busted so the patched ObjectBrowser is actually loaded
ObjectBrowser value cells stop row-selection propagation and no longer depend on an initialized local state cache before opening the write path
boolean, number, JSON and states values are coerced consistently before socket.setState
writes use ack=false and q=0 by default and the dialog closes only after setState succeeds
objects-page observers avoid characterData/class churn to improve frontend performance
delete/logquiet/role-guard behavior from previous fixes is preserved
notes: Hardfix for manual writable datapoint writes in the data point/object browser view. The shipped module-federation, ObjectBrowser and fallback writer assets are cache-busted and patched together.
description: Reliable data point write fallback and objects page performance guard
